hotel_name: Hotel Sun International- Budget Hotel Near New Delhi Railway Station

positive_snippets:
Comfortable and safe stay for families

We stayed at Hotel Sun International with our family and had a very pleasant experience. The hotel is easy to reach and located close to New Delhi Railway Station, which made our arrival and travel very convenient.

The staff was very polite and supportive. They helped us with extra towels, guidance about local travel, and made check-in smooth even with children. Everyone was respectful and friendly.

Everything needed for a family is close by — food outlets, pharmacies, shops, and ATMs are within walking distance. We didn’t have to travel far for daily needs.
Tourist attractions, markets, and shopping areas are very close, making it easy to plan outings without long travel.

For the price, this hotel is a great choice for families. Clean rooms, safe environment, and helpful staff made our stay comfortable and stress-free.

We would definitely recommend Hotel Sun International to families visiting Delhi.

Stay was good. New Delhi metro station was accessible. Paid early check in was allowed which was much needed for us. The food ordered through the hotel was good. 24 hours hot water was not available. Instead a bucket of hot water was provided 24/7. Rooms and bed sheets were pretty clean and maintained.
negative_snippets:
This hotel should not be listed on any booking platform. Sun International Hotel, Delhi is in an extremely poor and unhygienic condition, and the staff behavior makes it even worse.

The room was filthy. The bed sheets were dirty, stained, and clearly reused. There was no dustbin in the room, and when I asked for one, they handed over a broken, dirty dustbin that looked like it came straight from a trash area.

The bathroom experience was horrifying. I requested bathroom slippers and was shocked beyond words  they gave me used, worn-out men’s slippers, clearly reused by multiple guests. This is disgusting, unsafe, and a serious hygiene violation.

Housekeeping is non-existent. The flush was not working, and despite repeatedly calling reception, I was casually told that the plumber was “not available.” No urgency, no solution, no apology. Just indifference.

Take a look at the windows and overall room condition  broken, dirty, poorly maintained, and neglected. The room felt uncomfortable and unclean.

What’s even more unacceptable is the staff’s arrogant attitude. When I raised these issues and mentioned that I had paid via MakeMyTrip, the response was shocking:
👉 They openly said they “don’t care about MMT.”
This clearly shows how little they respect guests and booking platforms.

I booked this hotel after seeing some positive reviews, and I feel completely misled. The reality is the rooms are terrible, hygiene is zero, and service is careless and rude.

I have attached images as proof of the dirty bed sheets, broken dustbin, filthy slippers, broken flush, window condition, and overall room state.

Avoid this hotel at all costs. This place is not worth your money, your time, or your health. One of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had.
